llms.body:
# SIX Group

> SIX Group is a leading provider of financial infrastructure in Switzerland and Spain, offering services across stock exchange operations, securities, payments, and financial data products. We support Swiss, Spanish, and international financial markets with innovative, secure, and sustainable solutions.

## Company Information
- [Governance](https://www.six-group.com/en/company/governance.html): Structure, compliance, and corporate leadership information.
- [Contact & Head Office](https://www.six-group.com/en/company/contacts/head-office.html): Contact details.

## Sustainability
- [Sustainability at SIX](https://www.six-group.com/en/company/sustainability.html): Our ESG strategy, initiatives, and reporting approach.

## Core Business Units
- [The Swiss Stock Exchange](https://www.six-group.com/en/products-services/the-swiss-stock-exchange.html): Trading, listing, and market data services for equities, bond, ETFs. ETPs, sponsored funds and structured products.
- [Financial Information](https://www.six-group.com/en/products-services/financial-information.html): Data products including reference & pricing data, indices, and regulatory services.
- [Banking Services](https://www.six-group.com/en/products-services/banking-services.html): Interbank clearing, payments, ATM outsourcing, debit services and related infrastructure.
- [Securities Services](https://www.six-group.com/en/products-services/securities-services.html): Clearing, settlement, custody, tax, and related solutions.

## Insights & Media
- [Blog](https://www.six-group.com/en/blog.html): Financial news, tips and insights.
- [Media Releases](https://www.six-group.com/en/newsroom/media-releases.html): Official announcements and news.

## Careers
- [Careers at SIX](https://www.six-group.com/en/company/careers.html): Explore opportunities to join our team.

      Order Types on the Swiss Stock Exchange: An Overview

      Oct 29, 2026

      Anyone wishing to place a first-time buy or sell order quickly runs across a succession of unfamiliar terms such as limit orders, and market orders or stop-loss orders. These types of orders specify how and at what price your order should be carried out on the exchange. In this blog article, you’ll learn about the different types of orders, how they work, and which ones are especially relevant for beginners.

      • Blog

      AI in Trade Surveillance: Why Context Matters More Than Alert Volume

      Oct 22, 2026

      Co-authored By Francisco Merlos Fernandez, Head RegTech Solutions, SIX

      Artificial Intelligence (AI) is helping trade surveillance teams move beyond simply detecting threshold breaches. By bringing together transactional, historical, and market context, AI can help analysts prioritize cases, understand why behavior may be suspicious, and prepare better-documented investigations. This concentrates human judgment where it matters most rather than making it obsolete, increasing the importance of appropriate governance and oversight.
